title: Unlimited release folders with incremental OSS reuse
goal: Implement the approved draft-version upload architecture with no product-level total file-count cap, program-scoped reuse, one STS credential set per validity window, bounded metadata operations, atomic finalization, and scalable public v2 manifests.
global_constraints: Treat tech.md, explored.md, user-intent.md, and the user's implementation approval as scope.
Preserve existing changes in the dirty shared worktree and edit only owned files.
Implementation and tests stay in the same task; never weaken failing tests.
Do not commit, push, publish, deploy, open an MR, or mutate production data.
Do not persist browser File objects, multipart checkpoints, or temporary credentials.
Do not proxy file bodies through Netlify Functions or weaken OSS prefix permissions.
Only the coordinator may modify tasks.json and state.json.

shared_verification.expected: Drizzle schema and migrations are consistent.
Passes on an authorized disposable database or is explicitly gated.
Passes where configured or exact external gates are reported.

requirement_coverage.requirement: One prefix-scoped STS credential set per validity window
Bounded metadata requests and atomic finalization
Preserve existing versions and public v1

tasks.title: Shared contracts and canonical object key
tasks.objective: Define draft, bounded upload, and public v2 contracts plus shared canonical OSS keys without a total-count ceiling.
steps: Remove total-count constants and full fileIds contracts.
Define draft lifecycle/count/finalize, resolve/completion, file-agnostic credentials, and public v2 DTOs.
Move canonical object-key code to shared code with a temporary server re-export.
Update shared/object-key tests including Unicode and failures.
must_not: Do not change runtime server behavior, DB schema, or UI.
Do not expose secrets, DB IDs, object keys, or a total release cap.
interface_contracts: Credentials contain bucket/region/uploadPrefix/temporary credentials and no objects.
Resolve max 100, completion max 25, public page max 500, signing max 100.
Canonical key is prefix + sha256 + percent-encoded normalized path.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Shared tests prove browser/server key parity and stable invalid SHA/key-length errors.
Executable contracts contain no total file ceiling or full fileIds mutation contract.

verification.expected: Only explicit type-level rejection/runtime absence assertions may remain.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Owned files pass Biome and integrate with TypeScript after dependents land.

steps: Add lifecycle, expected-count, finalized-time, checks/defaults, and lifecycle indexes.

Do not require expected count for migrated rows.

interface_contracts: Draft is inactive with null finalizedAt.
Finalized requires finalizedAt; migrated expected count may be null.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Migration safely backfills before constraints.
Tests cover defaults, constraints, backfill, and preserved active rows.

tasks.title: File-agnostic STS credential endpoint
tasks.objective: Return one prefix-scoped temporary credential set without per-file target generation and preserve secret-free rate/audit behavior.
steps: Make credential request file-agnostic and response prefix-scoped.
Preserve PutObject/AbortMultipartUpload prefix policy.
Adjust audit/rate tests for one issuance summary.
must_not: Do not cache credentials server-side, weaken policy, add browser GetObject, or log secrets.
dependency_inputs: T1 credential DTOs and shared key.
interface_contracts: One prefix-wide credential set, no object list.

acceptance_criteria.condition: API/domain accepts no file list and returns no targets.
STS policy remains uploadPrefix-scoped.
Rate/audit behavior is bounded and secret-free.

tasks.title: Draft lifecycle and incremental association backend
tasks.objective: Implement draft creation, bounded resolve/completion, program-scoped reuse, atomic finalization, immutable finalized membership, and paged admin files.
steps: Add draft file repository/domain/module and tests.
Resolve reusable candidates with bounded HEAD outside transactions.
Complete uploaded files and associate transactionally.
Finalize atomically and make version/latest/activation lifecycle-aware.
Store summary-only audits.
must_not: Do not call OSS in a DB transaction.
Do not accept full fileIds replacement.
Do not reuse draft/deleted/cross-program candidates.
Do not expose object keys.
interface_contracts: Finalize uses ETag and expected count.

acceptance_criteria.condition: All-reused and mixed workflows produce complete manifests.
Missing object falls back, replay is idempotent, path conflict is stable.
Finalize is atomic and lifecycle-safe.

verification.expected: Passes; disposable DB tests separately gated.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Audits contain bounded summaries only.

tasks.objective: Expose finalized active release headers, immutable path-cursor metadata pages, and bounded selective URL signing while keeping v1.
steps: Filter on finalized/active/live versions.

Do not expose DB IDs/object keys/ETags.
Do not truncate v1 or select drafts.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Cursor pages traverse without duplicates or omissions.

tasks.title: Incremental and resumable administrator upload UI
tasks.objective: Create/resume/finalize drafts, resolve before upload, skip reuse, lazily share refreshable STS, and remove total-count UI limits.
steps: Add a single-flight credential manager and SDK refresh wiring.
Resolve selected metadata before upload and skip associated/reused items.
Create/resume/finalize drafts and remove total-count checks.
Add progress/draft UI and tests including 1001/10001 scale cases.
must_not: Do not persist File/checkpoint/credentials.
Do not acquire STS for all-reused folders.
Do not replace finalized files.
interface_contracts: Resolve statuses map deterministically to queue states.

acceptance_criteria.condition: 1001 new files use one valid-window STS request and 10001 metadata items stay batched.
All-reused uses zero STS/PUT and mixed/resume uploads only missing files.
Concurrent refresh coalesces to one backend call.
Folder/dialog/page lifecycle has no total-count error and handles drafts.
